implemented.metadata: 138-step additive lineage preserving all 115 effect-job steps. Scheduled/async owners, optional same-tenant async scenario links, execution receipts/deliveries, immutable schedule definitions and occurrence receipts. Private exact-key resolver enforces byte-exact nonempty tenant request keys; empty keys disable deduplication. Recurring tenant/scenario/instant is unique. Occurrence trigger also verifies scenario, iteration, source and instant bindings
implemented.repositories: Mandatory action-specific execution authority, copied three-kind queue policies and independent callback limit. Bounded create/replay/read/count operations, JSON SQL-NULL versus JSON-null preservation, current shared replay reads and explicit conflicting-key rejection. First request wins; no overwrite of changed replay bodies. Required job failure poisons the transaction even if ignored
implemented.lifecycle: Current SQL lease, exact identity, transport attempt, domain attempt and redrive generation fence all worker owner mutations. Resource -> receipt -> delivery lock order. Resuming the same domain attempt does not consume a domain retry. Completion/failure plus required next-domain/callback job plus transport acknowledgement are atomic; final expiry check rolls back local effects
implemented.callbacks: Separate callback and evaluation counters. Callback HTTP occurs outside owner transactions. Explicit expected-generation redrive cancels old available/running callback identities and invalidates their tokens. A remote send already performed cannot be undone; receiver identity-based idempotency is still required
implemented.scheduling: Explicit anchor, interval and shared catch_up/coalesce/skip_late policy. One active definition per tenant/scenario. Bounded tenant due cursor and at most 100 materialized occurrences per transaction. Batched execution/job/occurrence writes and skipped counts/watermark advance share one transaction. Published iteration is checked. No history scan or per-occurrence database read
implemented.calendar: User-approved corrected v1 local calendar contract: hourly/daily/weekly/monthly IANA schedules, independent month clamp, skip/count gaps and once at earlier overlap instant. Pure bounded planner and staged SQL preserve immutable spec, original anchor and separate local/UTC cursors; invalid/mismatched cursors fail closed. Initial gap skips counted at creation. New unreleased execution draft revised while preserving all earlier 115 steps; not an upgrade for an already frozen 138-step release. Source/public adapter and activation not supplied
implemented.transport: D23.1 typed ExecutionDeliveryStore exposes mandatory tenant/kind-authorized claim/heartbeat for the three execution queues over fixed-catalog lease machinery. Generic effect completion is not exposed. D23.2 owner RetryDelivery retains domain identity across transport retries and atomically fails owner plus inserts required callback on exhaustion. Callback-only expected-generation redrive preserves completed evaluation/result and schedules only a new callback generation
